body: LEAD DISPOSITION D10: ACCEPT THE AMENDMENT IN FULL. The playback-cursor versus epistemic-horizon distinction is load-bearing and was not explicit enough in the advisor proposal. Adopt the five-role split: source observation packet, narrative projection packet, alignment packet, coordination state, and evidence navigation, with saved-state receipts binding bundle/edition/axis/alignment identity. Adopt all seven courts, especially Play Is Not Know, mixed support has no hull, and recall backtrack is not screen slope. StoryAtlas owns playback and presentation state; storymodel4s owns axis mapping, evidence membership, epistemic visibility, narrative meaning, and estimands. One sequencing nuance only: a source-only MF2 diagnostic may exercise renderer-neutral packets before the human-recall vertical, but no production film workspace or recall voyage is claimed until ADR 0007 Stage E. This is a disposition, not code authorization.
